items.docs:
Utilize this endpoint to record feedback regarding the result of an ACH payment using the account information verified by Trustly during a Verification Transaction. This feedback data helps optimize account verification scores over time. It is **required** when using Trustly Connect. 

> **Note for Trustly Pay** 
> For apps using Trustly Pay, feedback should be provided on individual transactions rather than on the account. See [`/transactions/{id}/feedback`](ref:post-transaction-feedback) for t

params.name: verifyAccount
params.description: If true, Trustly will verify the provided account data. Default value is false.

items.docs: Convert legacy ACH ABA routing and account numbers or an International Bank Account Number (IBAN) into a verified token to meet NACHA requirements.

params.name: expand
params.description: A field in the API response to be expanded in order for more details to be provided (e.g. account.paymentProvider).

items.docs: Allows for verification of most global accounts by passing in an account object containing either bank routing and account numbers or an IBAN.
